name: file_read
label: 任意路径读取文件
description: Read a document from any local path (txt/md/csv/json/yaml/log/xml/html/xlsx/pdf/pptx/docx, ...) and return the extracted text; read-only - use it when the user explicitly wants a local file read.

filePath.description: any absolute local path, e.g. C:/data/customers.xlsx or E:/proj_help_sale/data/report.pdf
